text:
lucas: Ran through the python quickstart this morning and hit two issues: the sync sample uses `Client()` but the package exports `RedwoodClient` now, and the async sample link goes to a 404. Docs page: https://docs.redwood.ai/getting-started/python

rita: that's bad — can you paste the exact snippet you ran?

lucas: sure, i copy/pasted the sync example exactly:
```py
from redwood import Client

client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.chat.create(model='open-redwood/r1', messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}])
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

lucas: error: ImportError: cannot import name 'Client' from 'redwood'

marta: we renamed the main export in v1.0 to avoid masking a test util. the docs site should show `from redwood import RedwoodClient` now. looks like the quickstart staging build didn't pick up the new package index.

rita: the async example link on the page points to https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-quickstart/blob/main/async_example.py which 404s. maybe the repo moved under examples/ ?

docs-bot: filed issue #1024 in docs repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1024 (quickstart: sync/async snippets and broken sample link)

lucas: thanks. also IDE typing is off — autocomplete suggests `Client` in some places because of old stubs. we should publish updated type stubs and bump the docs version.

marta: agree. next steps: (1) patch quickstart to use RedwoodClient and an explicit import comment for typing; (2) update the sample-app link to https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/tree/main/python/quickstart; (3) add a docs CI smoke test that runs both sync and async quickstart files with a stubbed client.

rita: i can send a small PR for (1) and (2) — will include a short note about `# type: ignore` if users are on older sdk. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/378 (WIP)

devex: please also add a changelog blurb for the SDK rename so community users aren't surprised. we had a few tickets this week about it.

lucas: ETA: i'll verify once PR lands; can we get a tiny notification to the onboarding email list so recent signups aren't hitting the broken link?

docs-bot: added a soft alert to onboarding channel and scheduled a tiny announcement to go out if PR merges before EOD. :bell:

marta: thanks all. marking as tracking until CI smoke is in place + PR merged.
